name: Vanguard (Legendary Games)
body:
A vanguard hyper focuses on being a forward scout, always cognizant and ready for any ambush. They use their tactical knowhow to help them and their allies survive behind enemy lines.

Class Features
Lookout (Ex)

At 1st level, a vanguard adds 1/2 their class level to their initiative checks. Additionally, once per combat they may reroll their initiative as a free action. This ability replaces the get the job done at 1st level.

Tactician (Ex)

At 2nd level, a vanguard receives a teamwork feat as a bonus feat. They must meet the prerequisites for this feat. Once per day as a standard action, the vanguard can grant one of their teamwork feats to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear them. Allies retain the use of this bonus feat for 3 rounds plus 1 round for every 2 class levels the vanguard possesses. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of this bonus feat. Whenever the vanguard is able to select a new slayer talent, he can instead choose to gain an additional use per day of this ability and an additional teamwork feat. This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 2nd level.

Vanguard’s Bond (Ex)

At 6th level, a vanguard forms a bond with their fighting companions. As a move action, they can choose one of their currently employed combat tactics and grant the benefits of that combat tactic to all allies within 30 feet who can see or hear him. The bonuses or number of cantrips provided by this ability are halved (minimum 1). This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to the vanguard’s Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). This bonus does not stack with any favored enemy, studied target, or combat tactics bonuses possessed by their allies; they use whichever bonus is higher. This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 6th level.

Ever Ready (Ex)

At 7th level, a vanguard is never considered an unaware combatant and is always able to act in the surprise round. The vanguard is still flat-footed in the surprise round until they act. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 7th level.
